items.content_html:
Description

Updated the ImageData() constructor and ImageData overview documentation to note that dataArray can be a Uint8ClampedArray or Float16Array, matching the WHATWG spec and Chromium 137+ behavior.

Motivation

MDN previously only listed Uint8ClampedArray for dataArray, which conflicted with the spec, Chromium’s IDL, and existing examples showing Float16Array usage. This change ensures consistency across the constructor page, overview page, and spec.

Additional details

  • WHATWG spec: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#imagedataarray
  • Chromium 137 release notes confirm Float16Array support for the constructor. https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/139.0.7258.9:third_party/blink/renderer/core/html/canvas/image_data.idl

Related issues and pull requests

Fixes #40639

I have modified both the overview file and the constructor file.
items.title: Added reference to Float16Array in ImageData files
